messages:
Elliot: Heads-up: several tenants show preview token drift after we started shipping x-routing-policy on 2024-08-01. Preview totals differ from final invoices for routes that hit fallback pools.

Priya: Noted. The new header is meant for routing decisions, but preview-aggregator started using the full envelope as the attribution key. Billing canonicalizer ignores x-routing-policy.

Sam: So preview groups by (tenant, route, x-routing-policy) and billing groups by (tenant, route). That would split counts. Any sample events?

Elliot: Example (sanitized):
```json
{ "tenant_id": "T-501", "route": "gen-us", "x-routing-policy": "fallback-lowcost", "tokens": 420 }
```

Morgan: Quick fix: change preview-aggregator to compute a metering_key that ignores routing policy unless explicitly opted-in. I can put a PR behind a feature flag.

Priya: Also need a contract: internal headers used for routing must not alter billing attribution by default. We should publish a metering contract RFC and add a lint in the metering API.

Billing: Customer impact: preview confusion only so far, but CS is getting tickets. Recommend console annotation and a small rollback window for the header rollout.

OpsBot: Canary rollback scheduled for preview-ingest on canary hosts in 15m if flag not flipped. PAGE-4012 created.

Sam: Backfill plan: replay 48h of preview envelopes through a normalizer that drops ephemeral routing attrs and compute per-tenant deltas. Dry-run first and list top 50 tenant deltas. Estimate ~1.5 CPU-hours and 600GB IO per region.

QA Bot: Add CI test: inject random routing headers and ensure preview aggregator normalizes them by default. Adding to preview-integration matrix.

ConsoleBot: Draft banner: "Some preview totals may differ from final invoices while we align routing headers with metering rules." Approve?

Billing: Approve with link to status and ETA of backfill.

Priya: Action items: Morgan PR for metering_key + feature flag, Sam job spec for backfill dry-run, Ops canary rollback if needed, Draft RFC for metering header contract, ConsoleBot post banner.

Elliot: One more: add telemetry that counts envelopes where x-routing-policy is present and percent of those that affect preview buckets. We need a chart to monitor rollout impact in real time.

Morgan: Will add metric: metering.routing_policy_presence and preview.delta_by_policy tag.

Sam: Opening PRs and job specs. Tagging @Morgan and @Priya for review.

Elliot: Thanks all. Keep this thread alive for backfill results and any customer escalations. :thumbsup:
